testcases.prompt: Full-color outdoor photograph at sunrise, with a broad dawn sky <sky_1> above a green valley <valley_1>. On the left, a large hot-air balloon <obj_1> floats over the valley, while a smaller blue hot-air balloon <obj_2> hangs farther back on the right. Along the horizon, the rising sun <sun_1> appears between distant mountain ridges <mountain_1>, casting low orange light across the slopes and leaving the foreground meadow in cooler shadow.
